jobs.title: Director of Applications, Data & Integration
jobs.description:
On behalf of our Professional Services Client, Ignite Technical Resources is recruiting for a Director, Applications & Data Engineering: AI & Integration
to join our Client’s team on a full-time permanent basis. This role is Hybrid
and the Client is based in Vancouver, BC.

Summary of the Role

The Director, Applications & Data Engineering will lead enterprise application architecture, software engineering, data management, and integration capabilities. This role focuses on modernizing application development through AI-assisted engineering, DevOps, automation, and secure development practices.

Responsibilities include establishing enterprise integration standards, advancing data engineering and analytics, overseeing Microsoft Dynamics 365 initiatives, and developing technical capabilities that support digital transformation, operational efficiency, and scalable technology delivery.

Duties & Responsibilities

Lead enterprise application architecture, software engineering, integration, data engineering, and analytics functions.
Establish application development standards, architecture frameworks, and application lifecycle management practices.
Implement DevOps capabilities, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, source control, code reviews, and release management.
Drive adoption of AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and delivery efficiency.
Define integration architecture, API standards, and secure system-to-system data exchange practices.
Provide technical oversight for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Operations implementations, integrations, and platform enhancements.
Develop enterprise data architecture, data engineering pipelines, data quality standards, and governance controls.
Establish scalable reporting, analytics, and business intelligence capabilities.
Embed security-by-design, application monitoring, access controls, and data protection into engineering practices.
Manage multidisciplinary technical teams, implementation partners, and third-party development resources.
Establish engineering performance measures and continuously improve development processes and technical capabilities.

Core Requirements

Progressive technology leadership experience across enterprise applications, software engineering, systems integration, and data engineering.
Demonstrated experience establishing or maturing software engineering, DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and application lifecycle management practices.
Strong technical experience with enterprise application architecture, APIs, cloud platforms, integration patterns, and secure software development.
Experience implementing AI-assisted development tools, automation, and modern engineering practices to improve software delivery and productivity.
Experience overseeing data architecture, data engineering, analytics, and multidisciplinary technical teams, including external implementation partners.

Desired Skills & Experience

Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, particularly Dynamics 365 Project Operations, and enterprise Microsoft technology platforms.
Knowledge of enterprise data management, master data, data quality, lineage, governance, and business intelligence technologies.
Experience designing and implementing secure, scalable integration architectures, APIs, and enterprise application interfaces.
Experience with AI-assisted coding tools, automated quality assurance, DevSecOps, and cloud-native application development.
Experience establishing engineering standards, application security controls, performance monitoring, and enterprise technology modernization practices.

Terms

This is a full-time permanent opportunity based in Vancouver, BC, with a hybrid work arrangement requiring 2 days per week onsite. The position includes RRSP matching of up to 3%, extended medical and dental coverage, and long-term and short-term disability benefits through a cost-shared program. A discretionary annual bonus of up to 10% is also available. Standard pre-employment and offer requirements may apply.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

A member of the Market Strategy leadership team, reporting to the VP, Market Strategy, the Director, Business Intelligence & Go-to-Market is responsible for translating commercial strategy into action and using market, customer, and business data to measure performance, identify opportunities, and continuously optimize plans. The role brings together business intelligence, market analytics, strategic planning, and go-to-market capabilities to drive stronger commercial decision-making and execution. The ultimate objective is to identify and unlock growth opportunities, sharpen commercial priorities and investment, and elevate execution to deliver against Arterra’s long-term plan.

The Director will lead the development of analytics, insights, and tools that enable the business to clearly understand where to play, how to win, and where to invest, while partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and senior leadership to turn strategy into measurable results. This position is based out of our Mississauga head office (hybrid work model / 3 days in office) and reports to the Vice-President of Market Strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Business Performance Management. A key contributor to the monthly business cycle informing management on performance KPIs across category, volume, and market share (brand, geography, segment, pack etc.). Leverage compelling story-telling to clearly articulate performance drivers in a concise manner, with clear calls-to-action / next steps.
Data Transformation: lead the journey in partnership with IT to fully democratize and automate our data set. First, solidify the integrity and accuracy of our data in order to create organizational trust. Second, build visulisation tools with PowerBI that prevents the need for offline work. Finally, support the change management involved by offering training and assist first time users in the adoption journey.
Commercial Planning: Lead the development of the annual commercial planning process for the sales team on a national and regional basis. Act as an ‘entreprise’ ambassador to the commercial teams to help facilitate strategy translation into regional execution.
Go-To-Market: day to day execution of our annual sales plan through price, promotion, NPD launches, and shopper programming performance. Strive for continuous improvement in commercial ROI across the different levers of investment. Lead the monthly market PRs with clear & concise storytelling on key performance drivers.
Leadership: Raising the talent level through continuous development of a team of direct reports and their respective team members. Building strong succession planning and recruitment initiatives. Drive engagement across the team. Act as a senior leader of the market strategy group.

What You Bring

10+ years progressive experience in packaged goods industry specially sales intelligence, FP&A, RGM, GTM functions
Previous leadership experience managing mid-size teams ( Alc Bev Experience
Proven analytical and storytelling capability.
Ability to diagnose complex business problems and communicate outputs clearly through compelling visuals and excellent verbal skills.
Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate with Senior Leadership both internally and externally
Provides direction, support, reinforcement and coaching to create a high-commitment, high-performing work team
Utilizes a disciplined approach to define problems, identify root causes, evaluate data from a variety of sources, generate alternative solutions and choose the best solution
Ability to use information in an effective and timely manner to allocate resources and achieve business goals
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Demonstrated organizational, co-ordination and time management skills
Demonstrates a high level of follow through and ability to meet multiple deadlines

What We Offer

Hybrid work model, allowing employees to balance remote and in-office work.
Competitive Salary and Bonus.
Benefits and Pension Plan.
Product Allowances.
Training & Development Programs.
Tuition Reimbursement.
Commitment to Corporate Social Responsibility.
A chance to explore and learn more about the Wine industry.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Insights & Analytics
jobs.description:
Company Description

About Us:

With a history that dates back over 80 years, Starcom is a global communications planning and media leader. We are an agency still grounded in our founding principle that people are at center of all we do. Each day, we apply this belief to harness the transformative power of data and technology to inspire and move people and business forward. With more than 7,000 employees in over 100 offices around the world, Starcom partners with the world's leading marketers and brands.

Within Canada, Starcom is a part of Publicis Media within Publicis Groupe, one of the world’s leading communications groups. Our team spans across our Windsor, Toronto and Montreal offices. We truly love the world of Media and Advertising. We see the planning and buying process as art. However, it is an art that is always best when backed by the science of empirical data.

You will be joining a well recognised agency with credentials:

Great Places to Work certified three years in a row
Only communications company to be ranked in LinkedIn’s Top 25 Great Places to Work
2022 Media Agency of the Year
2023 Media Agency of the Year finalist

What We Offer

Work Your World program enabling you to experience working from anywhere in Canada or overseas for up to 6 weeks a year
Extended long weekends throughout the year with an additional day off each long weekend
Wellness & Tech benefits to support what’s most important to you
Birthday leave
Extensive Learning & Development opportunities, including more than 15,000 learning programs via our online learning platform as well as a Professional Development Allowance
Local and Global Mobility within the Publicis Groupe network

Overview

We are seeking a strategic, commercially minded Associate Director, Insights & Analytics
to lead and scale our MMM capability across clients and internal teams. This role will shape the agency’s approach to marketing effectiveness measurement, guide clients through data requirements and model design, translate complex model outputs into clear business recommendations, and ensure MMM insights are embedded into planning, optimization, and investment decisions. The successful candidate will bring media strategy knowledge, measurement experience, client consulting skills, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams and external partners through complex analytics engagements.

Responsibilities

Lead MMM Capability: Own the development and evolution of the agency’s MMM offering, including model approach, data collection process, governance, delivery standards, and client-facing best practices.
Guide Model Design & Measurement Strategy: Partner with clients and internal teams to define business objectives, KPI hierarchy, brand/category structure, base versus incremental measurement needs, and testable hypotheses.
Oversee Data Collection & Readiness: Lead data requirement planning across media, sales, revenue, pricing, promotions, seasonality, macro factors, and other business drivers; ensure data inputs are complete, consistent, and model-ready.
Manage MMM Execution: Work closely with internal analytics teams, data science partners, and external vendors to support model development, validation, output review, scenario planning, and optimization recommendations.
Translate Outputs into Action: Turn model results into clear, practical implications for media investment, channel mix, budget allocation, flighting, diminishing returns, and future planning decisions.
Serve as Senior Client Consultant: Lead client conversations on marketing effectiveness, explain model methodology and limitations, present findings with confidence, and build trust with senior stakeholders.
Integrate Insights into Planning: Collaborate with strategy, planning, investment, performance, and client teams to ensure MMM learnings are connected to broader audience, media, and business strategy.
Build Tools, Templates & Standards: Create scalable MMM briefing documents, data collection templates, QA checklists, output interpretation frameworks, and executive-ready reporting formats.
Advance Measurement Thought Leadership: Stay current on MMM, incrementality testing, attribution, media effectiveness, privacy-safe measurement, and AI-enabled analytics to continuously improve the agency’s measurement practice.
Drive AI Capability Adoption & Development: Identify, test, and scale AI-enabled tools, workflows, and best practices that improve research, analytics, reporting, and knowledge-sharing across the agency.
Support Broader Research & Insights Needs: Contribute to research and insights work as needed, including new business pitches, category and consumer POVs, thought leadership, client requests, and cross-agency strategic initiatives.
Lead & Mentor Team Members: Support the growth of managers, specialists, and analysts by providing coaching, quality control, project guidance, and capability-building across MMM and analytics workstreams.

Qualifications

8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, media measurement, research, consulting, or agency/client-side analytics roles.
Strong understanding of Marketing Mix Modeling, including model objectives, business use cases, data requirements, interpretation of outputs, and application to media planning and budget optimization.
Experience managing MMM projects end to end, including scoping, client alignment, data collection, vendor coordination, model review, delivery, and post-model planning recommendations.
Ability to translate technical analytics into concise executive narratives, clear planning implications, and actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Familiarity with paid media channels, including TV, digital video, social, search, display, audio, OOH, retail media, and CTV, and how these channels are measured and optimized.
Strong analytical fluency, with comfort reviewing data inputs, model outputs, response curves, ROI/ROAS, contribution, saturation, and scenario planning outputs.
Proficiency with Excel and PowerPoint expected; familiarity with Power BI, SQL, R, Python, MMM platforms, or other analytics/statistical tools is an asset.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple stakeholders, timelines, and workstreams while maintaining strong attention to detail and quality control.
Ability to lead through influence across strategy, planning, investment, analytics, and client teams.
Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities, with experience guiding team members and building repeatable processes or capability standards.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience preferred; advanced degree in Marketing, Statistics, Economics, Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related field is an asset.
We welcome candidates with diverse career paths and encourage applicants who meet most of the qualifications to apply.

Additional Information

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available throughout the hiring process upon request.

Salary

Transparency matters to us. The salary range for this position is $80,000- 90,000 per year. Actual compensation within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and applicable certifications. This range reflects what we reasonably expect to offer based on current market data.

AI Use

We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications or analyzing resumes. These tools assist our recruitment team but never replace human decision-making. We believe in a human-first approach, where your experience and potential are recognized by people.

Starcom is an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to diversity and inclusion. We create and nurture a vibrant work environment that celebrates, values and leverages all aspects of diversity and inclusiveness, attracts world-class talent and serves as the industry benchmark for best practices. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals and will provide appropriate accommodation for candidates with disabilities or accessibility needs throughout the recruitment process, upon request. Please contact our recruiter for any questions, accommodations or specific requests. We thank all candidates for their interest in Starcom however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: DIRECTOR OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
jobs.description:
About The Lacroix Medical Group

A leader in private medicine in Quebec, the Lacroix Medical Group comprises three rapidly growing divisions:

Medical Clinics
Operating Rooms
Biomedical Laboratory

The organization has experienced strong and sustained growth since its founding in 2009 and currently employs nearly 350 people. As part of its strategic plan, the Group aims to accelerate its national and international development.

OUR MISSION

To be the benchmark in private healthcare.

OUR VALUES

Passion | Respect | Integrity | Commitment | Innovation.

The Mandate

In a context of sustained growth and transformation of its activities, Lacroix Medical Group is seeking a Director of Information Technology who will actively contribute to the organization's technological evolution.

Reporting directly to the President and CEO, the Director of IT plays a strategic role across the entire network. They are responsible for defining, structuring, and developing the IT function to effectively support the organization's operations, growth, and ambitions.

They provide leadership for technology strategy, infrastructure, business systems, cybersecurity, data governance, digital transformation, and artificial intelligence.

He is also responsible for the performance of his team and the organization's technology partner ecosystem. This role is for an experienced, business-oriented, and results-driven IT leader who can combine strategic vision with excellent execution. Your Key Responsibilities IT Strategy and Governance: Define and deploy the IT vision and master plan in line with the strategic, operational, and financial priorities of Groupe médical Lacroix. Advise senior management on investments, risks, and key technological choices.

Performance and Business Continuity

Ensure the performance, robustness, and high availability of the infrastructure and technology platforms essential to the network's medical and administrative activities, including ERP, CRM, DME, LIS, SaaS, and cloud environments.

Digital Transformation, Data, and Artificial Intelligence

Identify and prioritize initiatives to transform the organization through technology, data valorization, automation, and artificial intelligence. Lead major technology projects and ensure their effective integration into operations.

Cybersecurity and Risk Management

Maintain high standards in cybersecurity, information protection, redundancy, and business continuity in an environment where system availability and the protection of medical data are critical.

Leadership and Organizational Performance

Lead and develop a competent, autonomous, and accountable IT team. Establish clear objectives and performance indicators, ensure rigorous budget management, and optimize the contribution of suppliers, consultants, and technology partners.

An Executive Role Close to Operations

At Lacroix Medical Group, technology must meet the realities on the ground.

The IT Director will therefore need to maintain close contact with the various business units and network teams to understand their needs, anticipate challenges, and ensure that technological solutions contribute concretely to operational performance and service quality.

The position consequently requires excellent mobility. The successful candidate will be required to travel regularly throughout the Lacroix network in Quebec to meet with teams, support projects, and remain connected to the operational realities of the various facilities.

This on-the-ground presence is an essential component of the role and not an occasional responsibility.

The mandate expressly includes regular visits to service points.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for an experienced manager with a strong business acumen and excellent technological expertise, recognized for their leadership, judgment, and ability to drive organizational growth.

The Ideal Candidate Will Possess

A bachelor's degree in computer engineering, computer science, or a related field;
15 to 20 years of experience in information technology, including a minimum of 5 years in a management role;
Mastery of software architecture and project management;
A solid understanding of multi-site and cloud infrastructures;
Good knowledge of SaaS environments and major business platforms: ERP, CRM, financial systems, telephony, Microsoft 365, and others;
A thorough understanding of the issues cybersecurity, data governance and valorization, and artificial intelligence;
Proven experience in team management and development;
Recognized leadership in transformation and change management;
Ability to prioritize, make decisions, and manage effectively in a complex and evolving environment;
Excellent business acumen and the ability to communicate technological issues to senior management;
Fluency in French and English, both written and spoken;
A valid driver's license, a vehicle, and significant availability for regular travel throughout the network.

The Leader Profile We Are Looking For

Beyond technological expertise, we are looking for someone who stands out for their ability to mobilize, structure, and deliver.

A positive and committed leader with a strong sense of Accountability, the ability to build high-performing teams, manage rigorously, challenge the status quo, and transform technological challenges into concrete solutions for the business. The IT Director must be equally comfortable discussing strategy with senior management and understanding the challenges faced by teams in the field. Conditions and Compensation Lacroix Medical Group offers a competitive total compensation package including: Annual salary of $140,000 to $175,000, depending on experience and expertise; 4 weeks of vacation and 4 paid personal days; RRSP+ program with employer contribution; Cell phone allowance; Lacroix Health Credit; and an annual Lacroix gift card. This benefit can be combined with other benefits for personalized medical services.

Business travel expense account for trips outside your usual work area

Join a growing network and become a key player in the future of private medicine in Quebec.

Apply now and make a real difference.

Experience implementing or supporting SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions.
Experience with SAP Finance configuration and integrations across MM and SD modules.
Proven Solution Architecture experience designing enterprise finance technology solutions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including development of business cases, investment justification, and value realization frameworks.
Bachelor's degree in information technology, Business, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Skills/Experience

Consulting experience in business process transformation, operating model design, or corporate strategy.
Knowledge of Treasury Management, Cash Management, Financial Close, Accounting Operations, and Financial Planning processes.
Experience working with Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Procurement, and Supply Chain functions.
Familiarity with enterprise integration platforms, APIs, cloud technologies, and modern architecture frameworks.
Experience managing strategic technology vendors and system integrators.
Advanced degree (MBA, MS, or related discipline).
Experience within healthcare, pharmaceutical, distribution, or regulated industries.

jobs.description:
FNHA Overview

The First Nations Health Authority is a diverse and transformational health organization of professional, innovative, and dedicated team members and leaders.

The first of its kind in Canada, FNHA works as a health-and-wellness partner with BC First Nations to support self-determination and decision-making to improve health outcomes.

The First Nations Health Authority is committed to respecting diversity within our workforce; preference will be given to individuals who identify as First Nations, Inuit, or Métis. All interested First Nations, Inuit or Métis individuals are encouraged to apply. The First Nations Health Authority has a mandate to increase First Nations, Inuit or Métis representation in the workforce. Applicant skills, perspectives and lived experience may be matched for this role, or other opportunities within the FNHA.

FNHA is proud to have been named one of BC’s Top Employers for 2026. Learn more about why we were selected here .

Title:
Chief Financial Officer and Vice President of Information Management and Information Technology

Salary:
$226,000- $282,000 per year (targeted salary)

Contract
: Permanent

Hours:
Full-time, 37.5 hours per week (core hours 9am-3pm Mon-Fri)

Location
: Metro Vancouver– Hybrid (Hybrid working is an option in line with FNHA’s flex work policy). Please note, this role will be relocating to our new office building in North Vancouver on Tsleil-Waututh Nation (TWN) land, south of Mount Seymour Parkway in Spring 2027.

About The Role

The Chief Financial Officer and Vice President of Information Management and Information Technology (CFO) - reporting to the CEO - holds an executive role that shapes and directs the financial and digital strategy in alignment with the FNHA's objectives for First Nations health in British Columbia. Entrusted with overseeing all financial and fiscal management aspects of a highly complex, multi-partner organization, the CFO handles a range of functions, from budgeting and financial reporting to forecasting and risk management, ensuring these elements support the organization's mission and quality services. Additionally, the CFO provides strategic direction in leading Information Management and Information Technology, critical functions that ensure the organization's data, digital health, and information security infrastructure to ensure service excellence.

We are seeking a talented and experienced Data Scientist to join our Data Cognition Team at BMO Capital Markets. As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for developing and implementing advanced analytics and machine learning models to support algorithmic trading strategies, and drive business decisions in the front office, Investment Banking, and Corporate Banking. About Us:

With a history that dates back over 80 years, Starcom is a global communications planning and media leader. We are an agency still grounded in our founding principle that people are at center of all we do. Each day, we apply this belief to harness the transformative power of data and technology to inspire and move people and business forward. With more than 7,000 employees in over 100 offices around the world, Starcom partners with the world's leading marketers and brands.

Within Canada, Starcom is a part of Publicis Media within Publicis Groupe, one of the world’s leading communications groups. Our team spans across our Windsor, Toronto and Montreal offices. We truly love the world of Media and Advertising. We see the planning and buying process as art. However, it is an art that is always best when backed by the science of empirical data.

You will be joining a well recognised agency with credentials:

Great Places to Work certified three years in a row
Only communications company to be ranked in LinkedIn’s Top 25 Great Places to Work
2022 Media Agency of the Year
2023 Media Agency of the Year finalist

What We Offer

Work Your World program enabling you to experience working from anywhere in Canada or overseas for up to 6 weeks a year
Extended long weekends throughout the year with an additional day off each long weekend
Wellness & Tech benefits to support what’s most important to you
Birthday leave
Extensive Learning & Development opportunities, including more than 15,000 learning programs via our online learning platform as well as a Professional Development Allowance
Local and Global Mobility within the Publicis Groupe network

Overview

We are seeking a strategic, commercially minded Associate Director, Insights & Analytics
to lead and scale our MMM capability across clients and internal teams. This role will shape the agency’s approach to marketing effectiveness measurement, guide clients through data requirements and model design, translate complex model outputs into clear business recommendations, and ensure MMM insights are embedded into planning, optimization, and investment decisions. The successful candidate will bring media strategy knowledge, measurement experience, client consulting skills, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams and external partners through complex analytics engagements.

Responsibilities

Lead MMM Capability: Own the development and evolution of the agency’s MMM offering, including model approach, data collection process, governance, delivery standards, and client-facing best practices.
Guide Model Design & Measurement Strategy: Partner with clients and internal teams to define business objectives, KPI hierarchy, brand/category structure, base versus incremental measurement needs, and testable hypotheses.
Oversee Data Collection & Readiness: Lead data requirement planning across media, sales, revenue, pricing, promotions, seasonality, macro factors, and other business drivers; ensure data inputs are complete, consistent, and model-ready.
Manage MMM Execution: Work closely with internal analytics teams, data science partners, and external vendors to support model development, validation, output review, scenario planning, and optimization recommendations.
Translate Outputs into Action: Turn model results into clear, practical implications for media investment, channel mix, budget allocation, flighting, diminishing returns, and future planning decisions.
Serve as Senior Client Consultant: Lead client conversations on marketing effectiveness, explain model methodology and limitations, present findings with confidence, and build trust with senior stakeholders.
Integrate Insights into Planning: Collaborate with strategy, planning, investment, performance, and client teams to ensure MMM learnings are connected to broader audience, media, and business strategy.
Build Tools, Templates & Standards: Create scalable MMM briefing documents, data collection templates, QA checklists, output interpretation frameworks, and executive-ready reporting formats.
Advance Measurement Thought Leadership: Stay current on MMM, incrementality testing, attribution, media effectiveness, privacy-safe measurement, and AI-enabled analytics to continuously improve the agency’s measurement practice.
Drive AI Capability Adoption & Development: Identify, test, and scale AI-enabled tools, workflows, and best practices that improve research, analytics, reporting, and knowledge-sharing across the agency.
Support Broader Research & Insights Needs: Contribute to research and insights work as needed, including new business pitches, category and consumer POVs, thought leadership, client requests, and cross-agency strategic initiatives.
Lead & Mentor Team Members: Support the growth of managers, specialists, and analysts by providing coaching, quality control, project guidance, and capability-building across MMM and analytics workstreams.

Qualifications

8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, media measurement, research, consulting, or agency/client-side analytics roles.
Strong understanding of Marketing Mix Modeling, including model objectives, business use cases, data requirements, interpretation of outputs, and application to media planning and budget optimization.
Experience managing MMM projects end to end, including scoping, client alignment, data collection, vendor coordination, model review, delivery, and post-model planning recommendations.
Ability to translate technical analytics into concise executive narratives, clear planning implications, and actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Familiarity with paid media channels, including TV, digital video, social, search, display, audio, OOH, retail media, and CTV, and how these channels are measured and optimized.
Strong analytical fluency, with comfort reviewing data inputs, model outputs, response curves, ROI/ROAS, contribution, saturation, and scenario planning outputs.
Proficiency with Excel and PowerPoint expected; familiarity with Power BI, SQL, R, Python, MMM platforms, or other analytics/statistical tools is an asset.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple stakeholders, timelines, and workstreams while maintaining strong attention to detail and quality control.
Ability to lead through influence across strategy, planning, investment, analytics, and client teams.
Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities, with experience guiding team members and building repeatable processes or capability standards.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience preferred; advanced degree in Marketing, Statistics, Economics, Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related field is an asset.
We welcome candidates with diverse career paths and encourage applicants who meet most of the qualifications to apply.

Additional Information

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available throughout the hiring process upon request.

Salary

Transparency matters to us. The salary range for this position is $80,000- 90,000 per year. Actual compensation within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and applicable certifications. This range reflects what we reasonably expect to offer based on current market data.

We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications or analyzing resumes. These tools assist our recruitment team but never replace human decision-making. We believe in a human-first approach, where your experience and potential are recognized by people.

A leader in private medicine in Quebec, the Lacroix Medical Group comprises three rapidly growing divisions:

Medical Clinics
Operating Rooms
Biomedical Laboratory

The organization has experienced strong and sustained growth since its founding in 2009 and currently employs nearly 350 people. As part of its strategic plan, the Group aims to accelerate its national and international development.

OUR MISSION

To be the benchmark in private healthcare.

OUR VALUES

Passion | Respect | Integrity | Commitment | Innovation.

The Mandate

In a context of sustained growth and transformation of its activities, Lacroix Medical Group is seeking a Director of Information Technology who will actively contribute to the organization's technological evolution.

Reporting directly to the President and CEO, the Director of IT plays a strategic role across the entire network. They are responsible for defining, structuring, and developing the IT function to effectively support the organization's operations, growth, and ambitions.

They provide leadership for technology strategy, infrastructure, business systems, cybersecurity, data governance, digital transformation, and artificial intelligence.

He is also responsible for the performance of his team and the organization's technology partner ecosystem. This role is for an experienced, business-oriented, and results-driven IT leader who can combine strategic vision with excellent execution. Your Key Responsibilities IT Strategy and Governance: Define and deploy the IT vision and master plan in line with the strategic, operational, and financial priorities of Groupe médical Lacroix. Advise senior management on investments, risks, and key technological choices.

Performance and Business Continuity

Ensure the performance, robustness, and high availability of the infrastructure and technology platforms essential to the network's medical and administrative activities, including ERP, CRM, DME, LIS, SaaS, and cloud environments.

Digital Transformation, Data, and Artificial Intelligence

Identify and prioritize initiatives to transform the organization through technology, data valorization, automation, and artificial intelligence. Lead major technology projects and ensure their effective integration into operations.

Cybersecurity and Risk Management

Maintain high standards in cybersecurity, information protection, redundancy, and business continuity in an environment where system availability and the protection of medical data are critical.

Leadership and Organizational Performance

Lead and develop a competent, autonomous, and accountable IT team. Establish clear objectives and performance indicators, ensure rigorous budget management, and optimize the contribution of suppliers, consultants, and technology partners.

An Executive Role Close to Operations

At Lacroix Medical Group, technology must meet the realities on the ground.

The IT Director will therefore need to maintain close contact with the various business units and network teams to understand their needs, anticipate challenges, and ensure that technological solutions contribute concretely to operational performance and service quality.

The position consequently requires excellent mobility. The successful candidate will be required to travel regularly throughout the Lacroix network in Quebec to meet with teams, support projects, and remain connected to the operational realities of the various facilities.

This on-the-ground presence is an essential component of the role and not an occasional responsibility.

The mandate expressly includes regular visits to service points.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for an experienced manager with a strong business acumen and excellent technological expertise, recognized for their leadership, judgment, and ability to drive organizational growth.

The Ideal Candidate Will Possess

A bachelor's degree in computer engineering, computer science, or a related field;
15 to 20 years of experience in information technology, including a minimum of 5 years in a management role;
Mastery of software architecture and project management;
A solid understanding of multi-site and cloud infrastructures;
Good knowledge of SaaS environments and major business platforms: ERP, CRM, financial systems, telephony, Microsoft 365, and others;
A thorough understanding of the issues cybersecurity, data governance and valorization, and artificial intelligence;
Proven experience in team management and development;
Recognized leadership in transformation and change management;
Ability to prioritize, make decisions, and manage effectively in a complex and evolving environment;
Excellent business acumen and the ability to communicate technological issues to senior management;
Fluency in French and English, both written and spoken;
A valid driver's license, a vehicle, and significant availability for regular travel throughout the network.

The Leader Profile We Are Looking For

Beyond technological expertise, we are looking for someone who stands out for their ability to mobilize, structure, and deliver.

A positive and committed leader with a strong sense of Accountability, the ability to build high-performing teams, manage rigorously, challenge the status quo, and transform technological challenges into concrete solutions for the business. The IT Director must be equally comfortable discussing strategy with senior management and understanding the challenges faced by teams in the field. This benefit can be combined with other benefits for personalized medical services.

new_jobs.title: Vice President, Data Scientist
new_jobs.description:
BMO Capital Markets is a leading, full-service North American-based financial services provider, with over 2,700 professionals in 30 locations around the world, including 20 offices in North America, offering corporate, institutional and government clients access to a complete range of investment and corporate banking products and services. BMO Capital Markets is a member of BMO Financial Group (NYSE, TSX: BMO), one of the largest diversified financial services providers in North America with US$1.0 trillion total assets and approximately 54,000 employees as of January 31, 2025.

About The Role

We are seeking a talented and experienced Data Scientist to join our Data Cognition Team at BMO Capital Markets. As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for developing and implementing advanced analytics and machine learning models to support algorithmic trading strategies, and drive business decisions in the front office, Investment Banking, and Corporate Banking. You will collaborate closely with business teams and other stakeholders to understand their data needs and provide insights that improve trading performance and profitability.

Our Team

The Data Cognition Team (DCT) at BMO Capital Markets delivers a scalable, customizable, and sustainable suite of AI-enabled products for multiple business units. Leveraging cutting-edge data and analytics technologies, we solve complex business challenges and drive strategic transformation across Investment Banking, Global Markets, and other divisions.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and implement advanced analytics and machine learning models using techniques such as Generative AI, Deep Learning, and Reinforcement Learning.
Build predictive models for algorithmic trading across asset classes including Equities, Fixed Income, Commodities, and Foreign Exchange.
Collaborate with trading desks, investment banking teams, and corporate banking stakeholders to identify opportunities and optimize strategies.
Research and experiment with new machine learning techniques, including time series analysis, to improve trading performance and profitability.
Design and maintain reproducible machine learning pipelines for production environments.
Analyze large datasets to extract insights and support strategic decision-making.
Communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and present findings to senior management.
Visualize complex data clearly and concisely for business consumption.

Qualifications

Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related quantitative field (focus on finance, economics, or operations research preferred).
Minimum 3 years of experience in data science or machine learning; experience in capital markets is a strong asset.
Proficiency in statistical modeling, time series analysis, and machine learning frameworks.
Strong programming skills (Python preferred) and experience with cloud technologies.
Familiarity with financial tools such as Bloomberg, FactSet, and Thomson Reuters is a plus.
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to formulate hypotheses and learn from data.
Strong communication skills for effective collaboration with technical and business stakeholders.
Team-oriented, adaptable, and detail-focused with a results-driven mindset.

Nice to Have

Experience with Generative AI and advanced ML techniques.
Knowledge of investment banking concepts, trading strategies, and financial data formats.
Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices for model deployment and monitoring.

What We Offer

Join our dynamic team at BMO Capital Markets and contribute to solving complex challenges in investment banking and global markets using innovative technologies. We offer opportunities for professional growth, access to cutting-edge tools, and the chance to make a significant impact on critical business operations. Apply today with your resume, highlighting your relevant experience in data science and finance.

Base Salary: $120,000-$150,000 CAD

(subject to negotiation and subject to the candidate meeting the specific skills, experience, education, and qualification requirements)

Salaries for part-time roles will be pro-rated based on number of hours regularly worked. For commission roles, the salary listed above represents BMO Financial Group’s expected target for the first year in this position.

BMO Financial Group’s total compensation package will vary based on the pay type of the position and may include performance-based incentives, discretionary bonuses, as well as other perks and rewards. BMO also offers health insurance, tuition reimbursement, accident and life insurance, and retirement savings plans. To view more details of our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.bmo.com/global/en/Total-Rewards

About Us

At BMO we are driven by a shared Purpose: Boldly Grow the Good in business and life. It calls on us to create lasting, positive change for our customers, our communities and our people. By working together, innovating and pushing boundaries, we transform lives and businesses, and power economic growth around the world.

As a member of the BMO team you are valued, respected and heard, and you have more ways to grow and make an impact. We strive to help you make an impact from day one – for yourself and our customers. We’ll support you with the tools and resources you need to reach new milestones, as you help our customers reach theirs. From in-depth training and coaching, to manager support and network-building opportunities, we’ll help you gain valuable experience, and broaden your skillset.

To find out more visit us at https://jobs.bmo.com/ca/en

BMO is committed to an inclusive, equitable and accessible workplace. By learning from each other’s differences, we gain strength through our people and our perspectives.
